positiveStatement: Cards in the English, German, French, Italian, and Spanish sets were also available as Reverse Holos.
basis: The retained Spanish identity is GEN 58/83 (SPEC-0131); the set row names Snorlax 58/83 as Rare and the language section explicitly includes Spanish in the reverse-holo treatment. Applied only to that already established Western release. No ordinary finish, special stamp, edition or absence is inferred.
